results.name: Ambiguous used revision allowance
evidence: Approved scope includes “One revision round” and states: “One round of headline and color changes only, before acceptance.” It also states: “revisionLimit: One headline/color revision round; number of revisions already used is not supplied.” The client asks for “another round of edits” but does not specify whether the edits are limited to headline/color changes, whether acceptance has occurred, or whether the included round has already been used.
